name: eyebrow
label: Eyebrow
help_text: Small uppercase label above the heading. Leave blank to hide it.

name: show_eyebrow_rule
label: Show Gold Rule
help_text: A short gold rule above the eyebrow. Works with or without eyebrow text.

children.name: heading_text
children.label: Heading
children.default: How long does it take to implement HubSpot CRM?

children.name: heading_display_size
children.label: Display Size
children.help_text: Visual size, independent of the heading level. Follows theme typography.

name: animate_heading
label: Type Heading On Scroll
help_text: The heading types itself in the first time it scrolls into view. Plays once, and is skipped for visitors who prefer reduced motion.

name: description
label: Description
default:
A typical HubSpot CRM implementation takes 3 to 6 months, depending on the number of teams, Hubs, processes, integrations and the complexity of the data migration.

From first workshop to go-live, we take care of the architecture, configuration, migration, automation, integrations, reporting and user enablement.

name: lead_text
label: Lead Text
help_text: Turn on to make the Description text larger

name: lottie_file
label: Lottie File
help_text: A .lottie or .json animation from HubSpot Files. It fills the width of the column.

name: lottie_loop
label: Loop Animation
help_text: Off: the animation plays once and stops on its last frame.

name: media_side
label: Media Side
help_text: Which side the media sits on at desktop width. On smaller screens it always sits above the text.

name: stack_order
label: Stacked Order
help_text: Which column comes first once the two stack, below the Large breakpoint.

name: custom_column_size
label: Custom Column Widths
help_text: Off: the two columns split the row evenly, as SR's two-column modules do. On: set each column's width, offset and order yourself (this overrides Media Side).

children.name: column_order
children.label: Order
children.help_text: Which column comes first at this breakpoint.

children.name: column_order
children.label: Order
children.help_text: Which column comes first at this breakpoint.

name: column_vertical_align
label: Column Vertical Alignment
help_text: Uses the theme's own alignment utilities.
